entities.summary: Chester Chet Mason is an American former professional basketball player. He is a 1,93 tall guard who last played for BC Novosibirsk of the Russian Basketball Super League. Mason was named the Adriatic League MVP in the 2009–10 season, while he was playing for Široki averaging 19.9 points per game.
